description: Local QC construction from immutable strictly verified votes replaces duplicate signature verification. Saved baseline executable versus candidate; three paired repeats/load with alternating mode order by trial. Five-second offered windows,1900/2000TPS,20msonewaydelay,5sdeadline,16384inflight,durable64request/1msgroupcommit. Real Ed25519 remains on every constituent at receipt; externalQC and validators/recovery fullyverify unchanged. Timer ends after local QC domain/quorum/current-key checks. Shared8logicalCPU macOShost. Queue diagnostics off. No deliberate concurrent builds/tests/profilers during measurements; external time-l collects OS usage and includes startup/recovery outside benchmark measurement. Private fixtures removed only after recovery/report capture to bound disk use. Short runs, not capacity guarantees.

report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

decision: Retain the client-only verified-vote builder: all paired throughput and p99 comparisons improved, whole-run reported user/system CPU declined consistently, and no verification boundary is weakened. Validators, raw external certificates, recovery, signing and deadline semantics remain unchanged.
verification_scope: A private non-serializable token is created only after strict vote signature verification. Owned immutable vote and exact verifying-key bytes bind that result. Local QC construction rechecks kind/context/payload, committee membership, quorum, map-key/signer consistency, distinctness and current key bindings; it does not redo the same curve checks. Raw external QC verification remains full. End-to-end timer includes each constituent check and local QC construction. No authority flags are deserialized.
validation: Default parallel tests passed (2 deadline unit tests +12integration tests); diagnostic parallel run had a transient existing journal-lock reopening failure during concurrent process tests, then all diagnostic tests passed serially. Scoped all-feature Clippy and static independent guard review passed. Benchmark runs were performed after tests/review, without deliberate concurrent work.
